name: tinto-add-supplier
description: Entering an already-agreed supplier's record into Airtable's Suppliers table: name, type, region, contact channel, language preference, and payment terms, confirmed one question at a time, mirroring tinto-add-winery-record's architecture. Dedupes against existing records before creating a new one. For hotels specifically, web-sources property photos and a guest description (confirmed before writing, same pattern as a client's logo), but never web-sources the Hotel Cancellation Policy, that field only gets written from a real answer Tamara, Nelia, or Peter already has confirmed with the hotel directly, since a wrong figure here costs real money downstream in tinto-batch-book-hotel-rooms. Doesn't touch Supplier Payments (Finance's territory) or link the new supplier to a specific tour (link-tour-suppliers or tinto-batch-book-hotel-rooms' job once the record exists).
